policy: Owner requests measurement-count sweep on both locations. Six new independent jobs per device: same frozen hardware-chosen10/16/20 selector circuits and simple random/MI basis controls, raw and combined-DD/twirling at512/1024/2048 shots. Copy exact device-native QPY and metadata without recompilation/retuning. Fresh512 level avoids treating an older calibration block as contemporaneous. Fixed staggered level/arm ordering reduces monotone-order confounding but is not randomization or replicated calibration. Every PUB including readout calibration uses matched job shots. Publish valid-shot count/fraction/Wilson interval, unconditional objective, best sampled SQD objective/gap, distinct observed subsets, optimum found, and classical feasible sampling at both physical-shot and accepted-shot budgets. Charge is per entire job (circuits+controls+calibration), never invented per-circuit usage. No predictor refits or final-year reads; no intrinsic device ranking. Preserve intents and failures; no retry or extra parameter search.102 seconds worst-case per account,204 across both; check live usage before all submissions.
